audience: Engineers building browser agents who need validated click/type/select actions without model-emitted selectors
Adopters (e.g. Study-os) running guest UX defect crawls against a live product
problem: Script-style browser agents invent brittle selectors or executable code; people need a small loop that chooses among observed page controls for one natural-language goal.
solution: Ultrafast indexes visible controls, asks OpenRouter Decisions (typesafe/jev-1.13) for operation + target in one request, and only calls a text model when TYPE_TEXT is selected.
mechanism: Browser Harness / Chrome CDP snapshot builds an indexed element table
One OpenRouter Decisions POST returns operation and speculative target heads
Executor acts only on the selected observed target; TYPE_TEXT uses TEXT_MODEL_*
Independent outcome checks; artifacts logged for Study-os-style defect exploration

evidence.claim: A recorded Google Flights demo completes the natural-language search in about 7.1 seconds at 1x, with independent route/date/result verification.
evidence.supports: The repository records a timed Flights run (7.073 s) with model/browser work included after initial observation, plus matched-run comparisons.
evidence.limits: Three matched pairs are too few for a strong statistical claim; live network and caches remain variables. Does not prove every site is this fast.

evidence.claim: Supported decision auth is OpenRouter Decisions with OPENROUTER_API_KEY only; a TypeSafe key is not required.
evidence.supports: POLICY and OpenRouter docs name endpoint https://openrouter.ai/api/alpha/decisions, model typesafe/jev-1.13, and forbid requiring a TypeSafe key.
evidence.limits: Docs describe the supported path; readers must still verify the checked-in model client matches POLICY on their revision.

evidence.claim: A Study-os guest UX defect crawl against study.design-bakery.com produced action/decision artifacts and an 11-defect report summary.
evidence.supports: Committed benchmark folder records duration, pages visited, openrouter_decisions_ok, and defect_count 11 for the 2026-09-27 run.
evidence.limits: Status is partial; does not prove full Study-os PDD coverage or that every defect matches the external schema byte-for-byte.

boundaries: Does not book flights or complete purchases; demos stop at visible verified options.
Does not own Study-os product code or private study-log data.
Does not require a TypeSafe account.
Model output must never become selectors, coordinates, shell, or executable JavaScript.
No invented performance metrics beyond committed measurement docs.

preferred.OpenRouter Decisions: The alpha Decisions HTTP API used for operation/target choice
preferred.TYPE_TEXT: The only operation that invokes the separate text LLM
preferred.Browser Harness: Chrome CDP connection helper installed by uv sync
